It features interviews with motocross stunt rider Phillip Smage from Wisconsin, showcasing his high-flying backflips, wheelies, and other daring dirt bike stunts performed for live audiences. The video captures both the thrilling action of the indoor motocross demonstrations and the fan engagement aspects of the event, including meet-and-greets and media interviews at the Progressive International Motorcycle Show in March 2017.
